caption: The drawing depicts a single, three-seater sofa with a wooden frame. The back and sides of the sofa are slightly curved and swept back, and the frame is rendered in a reddish-brown color, showing carved detailing along the top edge and at the connection points with the legs. The sofa upholstery is made of a fabric featuring alternating light and dark green vertical stripes. The cushion, backrest, and inner sides are all covered with the same striped green fabric. The sofa has six legs, each cylindrical and tapering downward, also in the reddish-brown wood tone. The background is plain, off-white, and contains no additional objects or decorative elements. There is a signature in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Sofa
